first_missing_criterion: canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel AOI plus readable bytes from one of the five official OSNI River Basin LIDAR 2014 ZIP resources, needed to enumerate real archive-internal tile/files and bind an intersecting DTM tile with its official CRS. This unused official window confirms DTM/DSM products, typical 1 km x 1 km tiles, 1 m x 1 m grids, UK Open Government Licence, and five exact resource UUIDs/ZIP download paths; Stonyford redirected to an inaccessible signed object and the other four ZIP fetches returned Cache miss, so no archive-internal tile/file or CRS is fabricated.
